description: This file defines an abstract base class 'FormBase' for Drupal forms, providing common functionalities such as service injection, configuration management, request handling, and redirection. It uses multiple traits for modular features and implements interfaces for dependency injection and form handling.

classes.name: FormBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base implementation for Drupal forms, handling service injection, configuration, request, and redirection functionalities.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of the form, injecting services from the container.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration object by name.

methods.name: configFactory
methods.description: Gets the configuration factory, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: resetConfigFactory
methods.description: Resets the configuration factory to null.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP request object.

methods.name: getRouteMatch
methods.description: Returns the current route match object.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Generates a redirect response to a specified route.

methods.name: logger
methods.description: Gets a logger for a specific channel.
